OVERALL VERDICT: The live 15m/60m hit-rate elevations are not a confirmed trading edge: after horizon-sized block bootstrap and Bonferroni correction (alpha=0.003125), 0/16 cells survive vs chance, 0/16 survive vs persistence, 0/16 survive both. The accumulated 15m/60m market_only rates span 47.5%–53.5% versus persistence 48.1%–50.0%; the small, short live sample and third/regime variation are consistent with a trending/regime or sample artifact rather than a stable edge. The historical pooled walk-forward baseline was only about 51.7%–52.5% at 15m and 51.2%–51.7% at 60m, with naive intervals already known to be optimistic under serial dependence.

bootstrap.type: moving-block bootstrap on chronological 1-minute row sequence

methods.fraction_denominator: windows with direction-valid n >= 10; smaller windows are listed but excluded
methods.fraction_surviving: descriptive count of windows surviving both direction tests; no new alpha inflation is applied to this fraction
methods.stability_verdict: consistent >=80% with every counted window n>=50; marginal 40%-79%; noise <40% or any listed window n<20
methods.tests: same cell_summary direction tests as cumulative mode, run independently per window

windowed.overall_verdict: The six-hour windowed result is descriptive, not a confirmed trading edge: 0/16 cells are consistent, 0/16 are marginal, and 16/16 are noise. The 60m cells provide only 13-13 windows with n>=50, too few independent windows to conclude on 60m stability; the per-window Bonferroni tests are confirmatory within each window, while the survival fraction adds no alpha inflation.
